java.lang.Object
com.viaversion.viafabricplus.bedrock.render.BedrockGuiActorContext
All Implemented Interfaces:

public final class BedrockGuiActorContext extends Object implements AutoCloseable
One retained GUI perspective. World playback and world effect dispatch remain separate.
